Definition: to encounter, whether accidentally or in a hostile manner
BiblicalUsage: 1) to encounter, befall, meet; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to meet, encounter; 1a2) to befall (fig); 1b) (Niphal) to meet, meet unexpectedly; 1c) (Hiphil) to cause to meet
